_comment: Real-world play surfaces. friction = constant deceleration coefficient, drag = speed-proportional damping, curlGrip = how much spin bends the path, spinDecay = fraction of spin lost per second. Tuned 2026-08-27 against the trajectory report: curl must bend a shot by roughly a quarter of the table width at full spin, and spin must die with the car so a turn does not stall.
